QA Review - 2026-08-10

Verdict

PASSED. Real Dev API checks passed for an existing public collection: authenticated user, a second authenticated user, and viewer role all received the same controlled detail response; pagination, encrypted output, unknown collection, and missing authorization also behaved predictably. With approval, two separate tester-owned singleton collection posts were changed to private and unlisted, respectively: the collection detail immediately became empty for both owner and another user. Each post was restored to its original public visibility, description, and category. No HTTP 500 or confirmed coding bug was observed.

Developer Comment Considered

Developer update QA interpretation
A collection will be deleted when its owner changes a post to private or unlisted, so separate hiding is unnecessary. Confirmed with approved reversible tester-data changes. Both visibility paths removed the singleton collection detail for owner and another user.
